items: [Baker's Rack with Power Outlets] Designed for the heart of your home, this kitchen storage bakers rack features Switchable dual-direction socket with an air switch, allowing you to seamlessly charge your blender, phone, or coffee maker without ever unplugging or rearranging your setup. No more tangled cords across countertops—just a clean, organized coffee bar station where everything has its place and stays powered up.

[Switchable and Reversible Design] This kitchen island microwave stand features a built-in power outlet comes with a convenient switch, allowing you to easily and safely turn it off when not in use—no need to constantly plug and unplug your appliances. The outlet provides a stable and reliable power supply, minimizing the risk of unexpected interruptions. Additionally, the socket can be mounted on either the left or right side of the rack to best suit your kitchen layout.

[4-Tier Shelf with 6 S Hooks] This microwave stand combines a 4-tier shelf and a coffee bar with pegboard to maximize space in your kitchen. The top shelf of the kitchen table is ideal for spices. The middle shelf can hold appliances like a coffee maker, microwave, or toaster, while the bottom two shelves provide ample storage for cookware. The bakers rack with 6 S-hooks offers additional organized storage, allowing you to hang mugs, spoons, and other small kitchenware neatly.

[Sturdy and Reliable Construction] The kitchen shelves bakers rack combines a durable metal frame with sturdy particleboard to create a solid foundation. The integrated "X"-shaped braces on the sides actively prevent swaying, making this a reliable microwave stand even when fully loaded. If your floor is uneven, simply adjust the four leveling feet. They ensure stability on any surface and protect your floors from scratches, keeping the entire unit firmly in place for daily use.

[Multifunctional Use in One] The stylish look is suitable for the kitchen but also be used as a coffee station, microwave oven stand, bakers racks, flower rack, printer stand or as a plant stand on the balcony, perfectly matching your living. Nice sleek design fits well with your kitchen, living room, bathroom, bedroom and any environment you need.

[Easy Assembly & Dedicated Support] The size of kitchen coffee cart is 21.7" L x 14.6" D x 49.4" H. Manual with detailed operation instructions, the hardware and tools included and each accessory is labeled for easy installation. We provides customer service before and after purchase. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
